artworks.title: Delphinium
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, central plant stem with swirling tendrils extending outward, creating an intricate shape. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey. The main plant stem is positioned vertically in the center, with tendrils branching off symmetrically to the left and right, some reaching upwards and others curling downwards. The background is a plain gradient of grey.

artworks.title: Dipsacus laciniatus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a spiny plant structure resembling a heart shape, with sharp tendrils curving around each other. The color palette is monochrome, primarily various shades of gray and black. The main object is centrally positioned in the frame, stretching vertically with thorny branches extending upwards and curling around a central axis. The background is plain and uniform, directing full attention to the plant structure.

artworks.title: Delphinium
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows large, curling forms against a plain background. The color palette is black and white, creating contrast. The forms are centrally arranged, extending in various directions.

artworks.title: Struthiopteris germanica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a large curling fern frond in close-up detail, showcasing its intricate leaves unfurling. The color palette consists of various shades of gray. The fern is centrally positioned, with the stem rising from the bottom of the image and the frond curling to the left and upwards. The background is a plain light gray, contrasting with the dark tones of the fern.

artworks.title: Saxifraga Willkommniana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture is circular with branching, leaf-like structures radiating symmetrically from the center. It appears to be made of a dark textured metal like bronze or iron. The sculpture sits on a flat surface in a top-down view, showcasing the detailed craftsmanship. The dark sculpture contrasts with the lighter background.

artworks.title: a Stachis grandiflora; b Nicotiana rustica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two large plant stems on a beige page. The stem on the left has a textured, vertical structure with jagged leaves. The stem on the right has a smooth, branching design with protruding spurs. The color palette is primarily gray.

artworks.title: Bryonia alba
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large leaf with detailed veins at the bottom center, and a spiraling vine extending upwards. The color palette is monochromatic, displaying shades of grayscale. The leaf is slightly off-center towards the left, while the vine starts near the leaf and curves up to the top center of the image.

artworks.title: Chrysanthemum parthenium
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a large, detailed leaf with finely serrated margins and multiple lobes. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, ranging from light grays to darker shades for a black-and-white appearance. The stem of the leaf extends diagonally from the bottom left corner, with lobed segments spreading towards the upper part of the frame, filling most of the image space.

artworks.title: Macleya cordata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a plant stem with leaves branching out symmetrically near the top, occupying most of the frame. The leaves have a textured, feathery appearance. The print is presented in shades of gray. The stem is centrally positioned, with the leaves spreading outward towards the top left and right corners, filling the upper portion of the frame. The background is a soft, light gray, contrasting with the plant features.

artworks.title: Ptelea trifoliata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a cluster of round, translucent seed pods attached to thin, dark stems in grayscale. The seed pods are positioned near the center left of the image, with the stems extending downward to the right against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Cucurbita
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of wrought iron elements featuring intricate scrollwork and twisting patterns. The image is divided into three horizontal sections, each showcasing different spirals and curls made from metal. The top section displays a single metal rod with a series of tightly wound helixes extending from each end. The middle section presents multiple spirals emanating from a central axis and flowing in various directions. The bottom section features another coiled element with looser and more elongated curves that wrap tightly around the rod, ending in a smaller, compressed spiral.

artworks.title: Adiantum pedatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays two large spiraling plant stems with curled ends, positioned horizontally in the frame. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting mainly of grayscale tones. In the top image, the three stems extend from the left and curl towards the center, each showing a tightly coiled end resembling a fiddlehead. In the bottom image, two stems crisscross, starting from opposite corners and curving towards the center, each also ending in a tight spiral.

artworks.title: Adiantum pedatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows six large, spiraling fern fronds unfurling, with each curl forming a circular shape at the top. The color palette is a monochrome grayscale with various shades of black, white, and gray. The fronds are positioned vertically, with their stems rising from the bottom and curving upwards to form the spirals, creating an organic pattern. The background is a muted off-white or light gray, emphasizing the darker fronds.

artworks.title: Aspidium filix mas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays two large, spiraling fiddlehead ferns with intricate detailing of unfurling leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and gray on a light background. There is a larger fern on the right side and a slightly smaller one to its left, both positioned centrally and vertically on the page. The spirals and the delicate fronds create an ornate pattern against the plain background.

artworks.title: Forsythia suspensa
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a stylized plant or flower in its budding stage. The central part of the sculpture resembles a tall, slender vertical element with smaller buds extending outward on either side. The material appears weathered stone or metal with a matte finish, giving it a monochrome, grayish hue in the photograph. The sculpture's surface is textured, with visible carvings mimicking natural lines and forms of botanical subjects. The stems and buds have a sleek, elongated quality, and the overall form emphasizes vertical lines and symmetry, giving it an organic and structured appearance akin to natural flora.

artworks.title: Aristolochia clematitis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a stylized plant form. It resembles a budding flower or leaf growing from a stem. The sculpture is made of a dark material, possibly a dark metal or patinated material, lending to its monochrome presentation in the image. It features detailed textures resembling the veined surface of leaves. The sculpture appears smooth and polished, with intricate detailing. It gives a sense of organic movement as if the plant is dynamically growing. The scale in relation to the image suggests it may be a smaller decorative piece, emphasizing fine craftsmanship and attention to detail.

artworks.title: a u. c Aristolochia clematitis; b Hyoscyamus niger
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: Three close-up black and white photographs exhibit detailed views of a plant with leaves and a bud. The images showcase the leaves' textures, vein patterns, and the central bulbous bud structure. The leaves are curled around a thin stem in the top and bottom images, while the central image displays the bud at the center with a portion of the stem visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Petasites officinalis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a large, textured, spherical object supported by a thick stem with curved leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray. The object is centrally positioned in the top half of the image, while the stem and leaves extend from the bottom. The background is a light gray, smooth surface.

artworks.title: Salvia argentea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a flower stem with multiple blossoms emerging in tiers along the vertically oriented stem. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of black, white, and gray. The largest blossom appears in the lower center of the image, with smaller blossoms positioned above it along the stem. The blossoms are detailed with visible textures on the petals and stem.

artworks.title: Salvia argentea
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up view of a flower head with detailed petals and sepals. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of grey. The flower faces right, with petal tips fanned upwards and outwards.

artworks.title: Abutilon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a star-shaped object in shades of gray against a light gray background. The object is positioned centrally with symmetrical points radiating outwards. In the bottom right corner, the number "63" is visible.

artworks.title: Michauxia campanuloides
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large cactus with vertical ridges and elongated, spiky dark elements resembling leaves or succulent stems. The color scheme is monochromatic, with various shades of black, white, and gray. The cactus fills the frame, with the ridged vertical part positioned centrally and the spiky elements extending downward. The background is plain gray, emphasizing the cactus details.

artworks.title: Salvia aethiopis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large plant with sharp, pointed leaves and stems covered in fine, hair-like textures. It is displayed in front of a dark background, emphasizing its silhouette. The color palette is grayscale, highlighting the plant's details in various shades of gray against a dark background. The main stem rises vertically with branched stems and pointed flower buds extending outwards.

artworks.title: Eryngium giganteum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, spiky-edged flower against a plain backdrop. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of various shades of black, white, and grey. The flower is centrally positioned, with its pointed petals radiating outward, filling much of the frame and highlighting its intricate texture and detailed pattern.
